name: GetNotify
description: Connect your business systems to WhatsApp. Automate transactional messaging, manage multiple brands and scale without building your own messaging infrastructure.
shortDescription: WhatsApp transactional infrastructure — Official Cloud API, direct Meta billing, no message markup.

positioning.forWhom: Companies that want to connect their own systems to WhatsApp and automate notifications, events, and operational communications.
positioning.not: A customer conversation inbox for agents, support, sales, and marketing.
